notes.title: THIS GAME IS STILL ALIVE!!! (and cheaper!)
notes.content:
Hello all!!!

Surprised to see an update on this game?
Yeah, well... here we are!

Even though this was a passion project of mine two years ago during lockdown, I still enjoy jumping in and coding whenever I have some free time...which doesn't happen much lately.
But I still managed to polish this game a bit more.

In this update I made all game modes immediately available to play. Just start the game and experience any mode you want. No need to beat Waves Mode in order to unlock the rest of them anymore.
I feel that the other modes are faster and more fun, so why keep you from being able to play them?
(It is however still recommended that you at least check out Waves Mode first before playing the other ones, just so you understand how the game works).

I have also noticed that many users have this game on their Wishlist, but they have not purchased it yet. 
Therefore, I have decided to reduce the game's price to just $0.99 USD. Which is half the original price.

Basically, in this update I have tried to make this game more accessible, more fun to play and cheaper. 
Just give it a try! 

Thank you for buying or wishlisting this game.
I hope you get some fun out of it.

COMPLETE CHANGELOG for v1.2.0:
- ALL GAME MODES are now UNLOCKED from the beginning.
- Increased game's brightness settings.
- Several UI improvements. 
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: DEATH MODE NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
"DEATH MODE" NOW AVAILABLE:
-New mode designed for more advanced players. Fast paced, with more power-ups, but very punishing!

Changelog for version 1.1:
- NEW GAME-MODE: DEATH MODE
- Added Screen Shake when using the Bomb and Laser power ups.
- Added a Total Time Counter for Speedruns.
- Added Steam Leaderboards for fastest time in Waves Mode.
- Added Steam Leaderboards for longest survived time in Lives Mode.
- Added Leaderboards (local and on Steam) for Death Mode.
- Added an Idle Animation for when the player stays stationary.
- Added increased Brightness option for people who felt the game was too dark.
- Options can also be toggled with Hotkeys (Music [M], Sound Effects [N], Brightness , Full Screen [F]).
- Added hotkey to Restart a run (R)
- Added the ability to take Screenshots and upload them to Steam.
- When a run ends, the Seed of the current run is now displayed above your score.
- Added the option to Restart a Run with the same Seed ("Restart Run") or with a new Seed ("New Run") after a run ends.
- Several UI improvements. 
- Minor bug fixes.
- Fix minor game balancing issues.
